name: Agriculture Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public agriculture data.

entries.title: FAOSTAT
entries.description: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization's global statistical database covering agricultural production, trade, land use, and food security for nearly every country and territory.
entries.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). Bulk downloads available via FAOSTAT's own bulk-download API in addition to the interactive browser. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.

entries.title: USDA Census of Agriculture
entries.description: A complete count of U.S. farms and ranches and the people who operate them, taken every five years, covering land use and ownership, operator characteristics, production practices, income, and expenditures down to the county level.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, National Agricultural Statistics Service (USDA NASS)

coverage.spatial: United States, states, counties, and outlying areas
coverage.temporal: 1840-present (2002 and prior in the archived reports)

entries.attribution: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service, Census of Agriculture
entries.notes:
The AgCensus landing page sits behind an Azure WAF JavaScript challenge: a plain curl got HTTP 403, though scripts/check_links.py reported it ok (HTTP 200) the same day. If the probe later reports blocked, that is bot protection, not a dead link. Human-verified 2026-10-31 in headless Chromium (HTTP 200, page text confirms "taken only once every five years" and the 2022 Census). The 2022 publication index, https://www.nass.usda.gov/Publications/AgCensus/2022/index.php, answers curl with HTTP 200. Table-level data is also reachable through the Census Data Query Tool and Quick Stats.
Cadence is quinquennial (every five years; most recent 2022). The schema has no five-year value, so it is recorded as irregular.
